title: ClientControlFrameV2
description: Complete held-state normalized controller inputs, not direct physical acceleration, velocity or pose assignments. Aircraft assisted-flight-v1 uses target speed/rate fractions; check protocol_info.physics.aircraftModel. Body +X forward, +Y left, +Z up; rotate X roll, Y pitch, Z yaw. Send at 30 Hz, increasing sequence per connection/session. Old/duplicate sequences are rejected; controls neutralize after 250 ms without a newer frame. Jump is rising-edge triggered while grounded. Unsupported controls produce no actuation.

rotate.description: Normalized rotation effort. Supported ground/mecha Z is steering: torque reverses during backward travel; clients must not invert it again. Ground/mecha airborne attitude remains body-axis effort. Aircraft assisted-flight-v1 uses target body-rate fractions plus server wing leveling and coordinated world-vertical turning.

brake.description: Normalized braking. Aircraft assisted-flight-v1 scales target speed by (1-brake); other controllers oppose travel.
